data.text: I learned to fish here from my family, and I want both our clinic and our lake to sustain this village. I commit to catching 15 tons this month and donating the $15,000 proceeds directly to the clinic, provided John, Kate, and Jack commit too and Luke keeps his catch at zero. We need the full amount without any extra harvest. Let’s also agree now on next month’s recovery limit of 30 tons total—6 tons each—then 10 each once the lake returns to 100. John, can you commit to that plan?
